LESSON: READING 9.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we read narratives?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a short narrative of about words for comprehension
2. apply appropriate reading strategies to read a narrative of about words for information

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read a short narrative of about words for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can read a short narrative of about words for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply appropriate reading strategies to read a narrative of about words for information
   In simple words: practise until you can apply appropriate reading strategies to read a narrative of about words for information. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading.
4. Show that you can: read a short narrative of about words for comprehension

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a passage in print or non-print format and answer questions,
2. Discuss vocabulary from the passage and use them to construct simple sentences,
3. Communication and Collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner answers factual and inferential questions in groups.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we read narratives?
2. What makes you enjoy reading a narrative?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read a short narrative of about words for comprehension
2. apply appropriate reading strategies to read a narrative of about words for information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
